```{r Projection Calculation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Sets up table inputs
additional_flow <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Additional Inflow to Lake Powell (MAF)", "Length of Addtional Inflow Period (months)"),
  stage_1 = c(0, 0), 
  stage_2 = c(0, 0),
  stage_3 = c(0, 0),
  check.names = FALSE
)

release <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Release Flow from Lake Powell (MAF/yr)", "Length of Release Stage (months)"),
  stage_1 = c(0,0),
  stage_2 = c(0,0),
  stage_3 = c(0,0),
  check.names = FALSE
)

output$additional_flow <- renderRHandsontable({
    rhandsontable(additional_flow)%>%
    hot_col("Parameter", readOnly = TRUE)
  })

output$release <- renderRHandsontable({
    rhandsontable(release)%>%
    hot_col("Parameter", readOnly = TRUE)
})


input_flow <- reactive({
  req(input$additional_flow)
  hot_to_r(input$additional_flow)
})

input_release <- reactive({
  req(input$release)
  hot_to_r(input$release)
})


key_elev_df <- reactive({
  # Parse comma-separated or space-separated numeric inputs
  raw_vals <- unlist(strsplit(input$key_elev_input, "[,\\s]+"))
  elev_num <- as.numeric(raw_vals[!is.na(as.numeric(raw_vals))])
  
  # If no valid numbers are entered, return NULL
  if (length(elev_num) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Construct the dataframe with elevation and paste0 label
  data.frame(
    elevation = elev_num,
    label = paste0(elev_num, " ft."),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# Passes inputs through projection function 
projection <- reactive({
  # Insures that there are proper inputs
  tbl <- rbind(input_flow(), input_release())

  add_release <-as.numeric(tbl[1,-1])#[row 1, every column but 1]
  add_time <- as.numeric(tbl[2,-1])
  release <- as.numeric(tbl[3,-1])
  release_time <- as.numeric(tbl[4, -1])
  
  req(length(add_release) > 0, !all(is.na(add_release)))
  req(length(add_time) > 0, !all(is.na(add_time)))
  req(length(release) > 0, !all(is.na(release)))
  req(length(release_time) > 0, !all(is.na(release_time)))
  
  ProjectPowell(
    Inflow = "CRMMS",
    Release = release,
    Release_Time = release_time,
    Add_Release = add_release, 
    Add_Time = add_time,
    Duration = 36,
    Storage_Data = hydrodata
  )
})

# plots projection
output$projectionplot <- renderPlot({
  fplotprojection(projection(), key_elev_df())
})


# Annual Tables 
inflow_no_add_table <- reactive({fAnnualValues(projection()[projection()$label == "No Additional Release",], "inflow", hydrodata) })

inflow_add_table <- reactive({fAnnualValues(projection()[projection()$label != "No Additional Release",], "inflow", hydrodata)})

inflow_table <- reactive({
  data.frame(
    `Inflow Volume Without Additional Flow (MAF)` =
      inflow_no_add_table()[["Inflow Volume (MAF)"]],
    
    `Inflow Volume With Additional Flow (MAF)` =
      inflow_add_table()[["Inflow Volume (MAF)"]],
    
    water_year =
      inflow_add_table()[["water_year"]],
    
    check.names = FALSE
  )
})

release_table <- reactive({fAnnualValues(projection(), "outflow", hydrodata)})

annual_table <- reactive({merge(inflow_table(), release_table(), by = "water_year")})
  
output$annualTable <- renderTable({
  annual_table()[
    annual_table()$water_year %in% c(2025, 2026, 2027),
  ]
}, digits = 1)


```
```{r output, results = "show"}
# Inputs
rHandsontableOutput("additional_flow")
rHandsontableOutput("release")
textInput("key_elev_input", "Key Elevation (ft)")

plotOutput("projectionplot")
tableOutput("annualTable")

```
